events.summary: Dravin deserts after seeing a blazing archon and weeping at the idiocy of war.
events.quote: I dropped my sword and wept at the idiocy of war.

events.summary: Orzhov start using hawks as messengers to bypass toll roads, creating a profitable business.
events.quote: The Orzhov started using hawks as messengers in order to bypass the many toll roads and bridges that dot Ravnica.

events.summary: Kitov leaves a checkpoint in the hound Ditri's care.
events.quote: Ditri, I leave this checkpoint in your capable teeth.

events.summary: The Festival of the Guildpact pauses violence for one day a year.
events.quote: for at least one day a year arms are laid down in favor of brimming goblets.

events.summary: Niszka calls for pruning Ravnica into verdant uniformity.
events.quote: Ravnica, like a hedge, must be pruned, leaving only leaves of verdant uniformity.

events.summary: Tharashk the Bold is erased from identity by a Mark of Eviction.
events.quote: Tharashk the Bold suddenly wasn't himself.

events.summary: Szadek expresses mixed feelings about sphinxes.
events.quote: Their wisdom I crave, but their secrecy I can't tolerate.

events.summary: Szadek is confident that House Dimir's truth will remain hidden.
events.quote: even the most perceptive would still be fundamentally unprepared for the truth of House Dimir.

events.summary: Sirislav tells of being ambushed and left in a latrine pit behind Tin Street Market.
events.quote: I found myself facedown in a latrine pit behind Tin Street Market.

events.summary: Agrus Kos describes finding a victim drained to a sack of skin and robes.
events.quote: As it turned out, it *was* the victim, insides sucked out—just a sack of skin and robes.

events.summary: Czaric argues for outliving mortal law through undeath.
events.quote: Why limit yourself to mortal law when you can outlive those who enforce it?

events.summary: Trivaz mocks the Selesnya and Aszala voices a taste for angel's flesh.
events.quote: My favorite meal is angel's flesh, slain in agony and iced with black vinegar.

events.summary: Pajik is amazed by his new powers while his cat Rivin is less enthused.
events.quote: Pajik was amazed and pleased at his newfound powers.

events.summary: Razia declares justice requires the suffering of the guilty.
events.quote: Justice is toothless without punishment.

events.summary: Razia says the pyres of unbelievers should light the way.
events.quote: Let the pyres of the unbelievers light our way.

events.summary: Razia credits the Boros with turning a wild goblin into a focused soldier.
events.quote: The Boros have given him the skill of a soldier and focused his heart with a single cause.

events.summary: A single wurm reduces the wealthy Rubblefield district to ruins.
events.quote: All it took was a single wurm to reduce it to ruins.

events.summary: Savra directs the planting of Golgari dead in a dark sanctuary.
events.quote: Plant our brethren here. This shall be our sanctuary.

events.summary: Svania Trul's last words doubt a map.
events.quote: This map has got to be wrong

events.summary: Yuri takes up the ragged Boros banner and inspires his brethren back into the fight.
events.quote: Yuri took up the ragged Boros banner, and his brethren, inspired by the act, followed him back into the fight.

events.summary: Otiev watches his hand deliver the sign of death in his own courtroom.
events.quote: But in his courtroom he was only a spectator, watching his hand deliver the sign of death.

events.summary: Brev Grezar admires a flame item as lantern and lance.
events.quote: Now *that's* military efficiency.

events.summary: The loxodon hierarch is willing to die to bring back the Ravnica of his memory.
events.quote: If my death serves to bring back the Ravnica in my memory, then so be it.
